errors.text_span: 蓝色曲线代表每日新增患者人数，绿色柱状图代表有关COVID-19的新闻报道数目
errors.evidence: The figure shows a green bar for daily COVID-19 cases and a blue line for news reports, opposite to what is stated.
The description does not specify that the chart compares daily global COVID-19 cases with related news report numbers.
The right y-axis is not described with its label as '相关新闻媒体每日报道数量'.
The x-axis labels are not marked at daily intervals; they are weekly markers.
